response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, highly experienced software craftsman with a strong generalist background spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure work, but his profile does not align with the core technical requirements of this role. His skill set centers on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with only minor, dated exposure to Java (robotic arms, mobile orchestration tooling) and no mention of Kotlin, Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate at all. While he has some IDE-adjacent experience (C/C++ work on NI LabWindows/CVI, a C IDE), this is unrelated to JVM tooling or enterprise Java frameworks, making him a poor technical match despite his seniority and clear engineering competence.
strengths: Extensive, diverse senior/staff-level engineering experience across many domains and stacks
Demonstrated IDE/tooling exposure (C IDE work at National Instruments) showing some affinity for developer tooling
Strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source projects
concerns: No evidence of Kotlin experience and only minimal, outdated Java exposure
No demonstrated experience with Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or other enterprise JVM frameworks
Current and recent roles are heavily focused on TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, not JVM ecosystems
